items.label: Elevated Regime — Relief Rally
items.detail: VIX 23.63 (down from 35+ Monday), regime score 0.40. Markets staging broad recovery on Iran de-escalation. Regime shifting from Early Risk-Off toward Neutral — watch VIX 20 threshold.

items.label: Iran Conflict — Resolution Pending
items.detail: Trump signals 'war is very complete, pretty much'. US Navy escorting tankers through Strait of Hormuz. Oil $87 (-8% today) but formal ceasefire not yet confirmed. Reversal risk remains.

items.label: CPI February — Wednesday 8:30 AM ET
items.detail: February CPI is the week's dominant risk event. Consensus: core +0.3% MoM. Hot print (>0.4%) reignites stagflation fears. Cool print (<0.2%) = full green light for equities. Do not trade through the release without hedges.

items.label: Adobe Earnings — March 11 After Close
items.detail: Q1 FY2026 after close Wednesday. EPS est $5.88 (+15.8% YoY), revenue $6.28B (+10% YoY). Stock down 19% YTD on AI disruption fears. Beat + raise = potential short-squeeze catalyst.

items.label: PCE January — Friday 8:30 AM ET
items.detail: Fed's preferred inflation gauge. Will reflect oil spike impact. High importance for May FOMC meeting rate expectations. Combined with CPI Wednesday, sets the macro tone for Q2.

items.label: Oil Volatility — $87 WTI (Was $119)
items.detail: WTI crashed from $119.48 to $87.17 (-8% today) as Trump signaled Iran resolution. Strait of Hormuz risk premium unwinding. But no formal ceasefire = binary risk for oil above $100 reversal.

items.label: Trade War — Tariff Regime Active
items.detail: 15% universal tariff in place. DXY at 98.59 (-4.8% YTD) reflects dollar confidence erosion. Multi-front trade tensions with EU, China. Stagflation risk if energy + tariffs hit simultaneously.

items.label: VIX Still Elevated at 23.63
items.detail: VIX declining from Monday's peak (est. 35+) but still above the 20 neutral threshold. Market is nervous but not panicking. Watch for VIX break below 20 as the all-clear signal.

items.label: Gold ATH — $5,196/oz
items.detail: Gold at all-time highs driven by DXY weakness, central bank buying, real yields declining. Silver +6% today. Even with Iran de-escalation, structural gold bull market continues. GLD trade idea in today's briefing.

items.label: HIMS — Telemedicine Re-Rating
items.detail: Hims & Hers Health surged +40.8% today. Wegovy distribution deal removed patent overhang. Telemedicine sector highest-performing industry (+30%) today. Watch for continuation or mean reversion.

items.label: Global Relief Rally — All Indices Up
items.detail: DAX +2.54%, Nikkei +2.88%, Hang Seng +2.17%, S&P +0.83%. Iran de-escalation lifting all boats. European indices (DAX -4.7% YTD, CAC -2.9% YTD) have significant catch-up potential if oil stabilizes.

items.label: Bitcoin $71K — DXY Weakness Play
items.detail: Bitcoin +3.96% to $71,130. Benefiting from DXY -0.59% and risk appetite recovery. Next resistance $75K. ETF inflows monitoring key. If VIX drops below 20, crypto risk-on trade accelerates.

items.label: USO Short — Oil Premium Unwinding
items.detail: If Iran resolution holds, $20-30/bbl geopolitical premium in oil continues to unwind. Gulf supply resuming as US Navy escorts tankers. Trade idea in today's briefing: entry $71-73, TP1 $63.

items.label: Healthcare Sector Leadership
items.detail: Healthcare sector top performer +4.2% today. Drug manufacturers (+30%), telemedicine leading. Defensive rotation remains valid even in relief rallies — quality over cyclicality.

items.label: DXY Below 99 — Structural Decline
items.detail: Dollar at 98.59, down -4.8% YTD from 107 in late 2025. Structural weakness driven by tariff uncertainty and trade war blowback. Supports gold, EM equities, commodities, and crypto.

items.label: Semiconductor Sector Recovery
items.detail: Technology sector +3% today. Broadcom, AMD +4.6%+ Monday. Semiconductor equipment industry top performer. AI infrastructure spending robust despite macro uncertainty.
